title: Polish Flatbread
description: A traditional polish flatbread recipe, crispy on the outside and soft on the inside.
instructions: Combine flour, polish seasoning, and zesty seasoning in a large bowl.
Gradually add warm water to the bowl and mix until dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 2-3 equal parts, depending on desired flatbread size.
Roll out each part into a thin circle.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Cook the flatbread for 1-2 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
